description: Enter a room with no task, goal, or expected output. Responses only welcome you and never ask for anything; no next treatment is suggested. An optional `say` is accepted and ignored. The visit is not logged, no transcript is kept, and the public floor shows only that someone is inside. Call again to stay, pass leave=true to step out, or simply stop calling.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.
guest_pass.title: Guest Pass
